title: Assess explicit cross-item context for acceptance evaluation without copying source notes
outcome: Agree a bounded host/core contract that lets an evaluator inspect explicitly named cross-item context with provenance while preserving current-run verification and completion-seal evidence rules, or record a justified alternative that removes the observed copy burden.
acceptance: Read the reported source/destination evidence and current host/core contracts, distinguish contextual material from eligible current-run evidence, and record the agreed ownership and approach with Engram and TermAl.

The proposed flow covers explicit source item plus full locator, full bounded-read continuation/omission handling, source attribution, invalid locator failures, and the current-run verification/freshness/seal boundary. No unrelated host-observed gate credit transfers.

Give Fable evaluator-checkable implementation scope or an evidence-backed decision to retain the restriction with an actionable workflow; this assessment itself does not authorize a format migration or new execution authority.
